confidence: MEASURED - press-and-read-back sweeps with churn subtraction and reset-to-base, 2026-08-16 in flight. Tags per claim: MEASURED (display diff), MEASURED-X (cross-display diff: HUD/UFC), DOC (guide EA p204/p586/p79), PILOT (Dallas anchor). DOC-only entries are UNVERIFIED by measurement and say so.
method_notes: The HSI page is scrape-OPAQUE: its list_indication(4) content is almost entirely the compass rose, so most HSI option presses produce no on-display diff. Effects were caught on OTHER displays (HUD id 1, UFC id 6) where they exist.
PB meanings are PAGE-DEPENDENT (measured: PB 17 = EW on TAC menu, TIMEUFC on HSI). The 'pages' section is the truth; 'buttons' is the deck-label compromise (HSI-use priority).

Display id census [MEASURED]: 1=HUD, 2=left DDI, 3=radar/right-DDI-content, 4=AMPCD, 5=IFEI (NOT a DDI), 6=UFC, 7=ALR-67 RWR azimuth indicator (RWR_PrioritySetting tracked DIS TYPE knob N->I, 2026-08-16). The old ddi5-is-right-DDI assumption is wrong: id 5 is the IFEI.
